{{Top}} {{MultipleIssues|image|updatecontent=[[Star Wars: Droidography]], [[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]}} {{Droid |type=Criminal |image=[[File:8D8-CGSWG.png]] |name=8D8 |homeworld=[[Tatooine]]{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars|cardname=8D8|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/370777/cid/22170335/2023-Topps-Star-Wars-5-8D8}} |birth= |death= |creator= |manufacturer=[[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines|Roche Hive]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' |line= |model=[[8D-series smelter droid]] |class=[[Smelter droid]]{{Databank|8d8|8D8}} |cost= |length= |width= |height=1.83 [[meter]]s |mass= |gender=[[Gender|Masculine programming]]''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' |pronouns=He/him |sensor=[[Color|White]]{{Databank|smelter-droid|Smelter Droid}} |plating=White and red |armament= |equipment= |affiliation=*[[Hutt Clan]]{{Film|VI}} **[[Jabba's criminal empire]] *[[Scourge]] {{C|as a vessel}}''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *[[Fett gotra]]{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}} }} {{Quote|Whether he was branding the feet of a GNK power droid with hot irons, removing the limbs of an elitist protocol droid, or simply blasting his favorite Sy Snootles solo album at sensor-shattering levels, 8D8 always knew how to bring the pain.|R0-GR|''[[Star Wars: Droidography]]''}} '''8D8''' was a [[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines|Roche Hive]] [[8D-series smelter droid]] who was lobotomized and reprogrammed to assist [[EV-9D9]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s chief of Cyborg Operations, in terrorizing the [[droid]] pool of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]]'s [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. He was temporarily deactivated after his master's [[Death|demise]] and later worked for [[Boba Fett]]. He presented those who came to pay tribute to the Daimyo, and provided information to Fett. ==Biography== ===Jabba's droid pool=== {{Quote|EV-9D9 may have given the orders, but it was 8D8 who actually carried them out.|R0-GR|}} An [[8D-series smelter droid]] manufactured by [[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines|Roche Hive]] and [[Verpine]] [[species]],''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' 8D8 was originally programmed to perform simple tasks in [[ore]]-extraction facilities. However, he was lobotomized and reprogrammed to serve in the [[droid]] [[torture]] chamber in [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' He became devoted to [[EV-9D9]],[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] a feminine [[EV-series supervisor droid]] that served as chief of Cyborg Operations, and assisted her in terrorizing the palace's droid pool to ensure they knew their place. Ultimately, many droids suffered because of his actions. [[File:DroidChamber-BF.png|thumb|left|300px|A powered-down 8D8]] In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]],{{BountyHuntDate}} 8D8 was torturing a [[power droid]] while EV-9D9 spoke to the [[Trandoshan]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]] regarding the whereabouts of [[261]], a rogue [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[astromech droid]] that had briefly been part of the palace's droid pool before escaping.''[[Bounty Hunt]]'' After Jabba acquired [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]] in [[4 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' shortly before the [[Battle of Endor]], 8D8 was torturing a [[GNK-series power droid]] by pressing a hot iron to his victim's feet while EV-9D9 assigned the new acquisitions positions in the droid pool. Shortly after, Jabba was [[Death|killed]]; subsequently, the Hutt's droid pool,{{BuildR2Cite|20|Droid Directory}} including 8D8,{{BuildR2Cite|21|Droid Directory}} were all deactivated. ===Working for Boba Fett=== {{Quote|Their tortured squeals will send a piercing message to all potential challengers to your throne.''"
"''I do not torture.''"
"''Well, respectfully, Lord Fett, on Tatooine you must project strength if you are to be accepted as a Daimyo.|8D8 and Boba Fett|}} With Jabba dead, his [[majordomo]], [[Bib Fortuna]],{{Databank|bib-fortuna|Bib Fortuna}} laid claim to the Hutt's throne and assumed control of [[Jabba's criminal empire]].{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}} Around [[9 ABY]],{{BoBFDate}} however, [[Boba Fett]], a retired [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] who had worked for Jabba in his former career,{{BOBF|Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine}} [[Attack on Jabba's Palace (Boba Fett)|murdered]] Fortuna and took the ex-majordomo's throne with the help of the [[assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]]. Forming [[Fett gotra|his own gotra]] with Fortuna's resources and territories as the new [[Daimyo]], Fett used a reactivated 8D8 as a diplomatic and strategic assistant.{{Databank|8d8|8D8}} [[File:GarfalaquoxTribute-BoBFCh1.png|thumb|right|300px|8D8 presented guests to Boba Fett as they came to pay tribute to the new Daimyo.]] When officials from the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]] went to pay tribute to Fett as the new Daimyo, 8D8 introduced the guests as they entered and took their gifts on behalf of Fett. After taking a gift from the [[Aqualish]] [[Garfalaquox]], the leader of Mos Espa's [[Aqualish crime family]], 8D8 presented the [[Trandoshan]] [[Dokk Strassi]], the head of the [[Strassi family]], and took the don's gift to Fett. The next guest was supposed to be [[Mok Shaiz]], the [[mayor of Mos Espa]], whom 8D8 introduced as the next arrival entered the throne room. However, the [[Twi'lek]] who entered corrected the droid, specifying that he was [[Mok Shaiz's majordomo|Shaiz's majordomo]]. 8D8 watched as the Twi'lek majordomo gave no physical tribute to Fett and instead demanded one for the [[mayor]], ultimately being refused and leaving. After the majordomo came the droid [[UK2-B]], who escorted two captured [[Gamorrean]] guards who had formerly served Jabba and Fortuna. 8D8 introduced the two [[prisoner]]s and suggested that their audible [[torture]] would send a message to any potential challenger to Fett. The Daimyo insisted that he would not torture, but 8D8 claimed that to be accepted as Daimyo, Fett must project strength. Instead, Fett, citing the guards' loyalty to their former masters as 8D8 had initially introduced, offered to spare the pair in exchange for their loyalty, which the Gamorreans agreed to. ===Interrogations=== {{Quote|What do we know of this prisoner?''"
"''He is of the Order of the Night Wind.''"
"''Assassin for hire.''"
"''Very expensive.|Fett and 8D8|}} [[File:Night_Wind_Assassin_Captured.png|thumb|left|300px|8D8 attended the questioning of a Night Wind assassin.]] Shortly after, Fett and Shand were [[Ambush outside of the Sanctuary|ambushed in Mos Espa]] by six assassins of the [[Order of the Night Wind]]. The Gamorreans that Fett had spared helped him to overcome their attackers, and Shand captured [[Unidentified Night Wind assassin|one of the attackers]] alive and brought him to the palace. After the assassin refused to give up any information to Fett, the Daimyo asked what they knew of the captive, to which 8D8 explained that he was of the Order of the Night Wind and was very expensive. Shand claimed that the Night Wind assassins were overpriced, but 8D8 insisted that their reputation was legendary, and that there was no way that the prisoner would reveal information. He added that they feared no man, and in response, Shand dropped the prisoner to the [[rancor]] pit. The assassin, believing a rancor was in the pit, succumbed to his fear and claimed that Mayor Mok Shaiz hired him. Subsequently, Fett and Shand went to visit Shaiz with their prisoner to address the matter to the mayor. ===Peel's petition=== {{Quote|quotestart=0|''[To Boba Fett] "''One of your vassals seeks an audience with you.''"
"''Do they have an appointment?''"
"''No, Mistress Shand.|8D8 and Fennec Shand|{{BOBF|Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa}}}} Later, 8D8 gave Fett a presentation on the history of the territories of Jabba the Hutt and Bib Fortuna. When first showing the businesses protected by Jabba on a [[Hologram|holographic]] display, he refused to say the Hutt's name in fear that he would offend Fett or make him feel threatened. Fett, though, was offended by 8D8's caution, so the droid apologized to him before carrying on. 8D8 explained the uneasy alliances Fortuna relied on to remain in power and that Fett's new subjects were waiting to see what kind of leader he would be. As Fett and Shand discussed the assassin attack before, [[Unidentified Gamorrean guard 1|one of the Gamorrean guards]] came with news that one of Fett's vassals wanted to speak with the Daimyo. [[File:Lorthas-petition.png|thumb|right|300px|8D8 helped oversee Lortha Peel's petition to Fett]] 8D8 translated the guard's words and confirmed that there was no existing appointment. Fett admitted the visitor regardless. The new arrival came in with the [[Unidentified Gamorrean guard 2|other Gamorrean guard]] and, per 8D8's request, introduced himself as a [[Water monger|water-monger]] named [[Lortha Peel]] and claimed that no one respected the new Daimyo. The droid angrily stopped the vendor, but Fett told his assistant to let Peel speak. Peel and the Daimyo discussed the disorder amongst the residents of Mos Espa, and the water-monger asked for Fett to help get rid of the [[Mods]], a group of [[Cybernetics|cybernetically]] enhanced individuals that were stealing from him. Fett visited the mods, but after hearing their situation, he hired the gang members instead. ===Delivering news=== {{Quote|Excuse me, Lord Fett.''"
"''Not now. I'm busy.''"
"''We heard back from the Mayor's office. He remains completely unavailable for the next 20 days.|8D8 and Fett|}} Not long after, "[[the Twins]]," a pair of Hutts and cousins to the late Jabba the Hutt who wished to claim their relative's former territories, learned that Mayor Shaiz had promised Fett's territories to the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. Thus the Twins, abandoning their claim on Tatooine, traveled to Fett's palace with a peace offering. 8D8 interrupted Fett's dinner with Shand to inform him of the Hutts' arrival and their gift. Fett and Shand spoke with the Twins, who informed Fett of why they were leaving, not mentioning the [[Pyke]]s by name, and gave him a [[Boba's rancor|rancor]]. While Fett trained with the [[rancor]], a request was made for another meeting between him and Shaiz. However, word came from the [[Mos Espa City Hall|city hall]] that the mayor was unavailable for at least twenty [[Standard day|days]]. 8D8 interrupted Fett's time with his new rancor, informing the Daimyo of the news. Thus Fett told the smelter droid to have Shand "suit up" for an immediate visit to the city hall. Fett and Shand traveled there and learned that Shaiz was working with the Pykes. ===The translator=== {{Quote|Master Garfalaquox asks what it is that you are proposing.''"
"''I am proposing that all the families of Mos Espa join in a defensive alliance until the Pyke Syndicate is vanquished.|8D8 translating Garfalaquox, and Fett|}} [[File:Aqualish-family.png|thumb|8D8 translated the Aqualish leader.]] Fett later held a banquet with the Mos Espa crime family leaders, hoping to gain their support against the Pyke Syndicate. As 8D8 stood to the side between two Aqualish guards, the Daimyo made his opening remarks. When Garfalaquox asked what Fett was proposing, 8D8 translated the Aqualish leader. Fett's initial proposal garnering little support, he instead asked that the dons remain neutral in his [[War against the Pykes|feud with the syndicate]]. When Garfalaquox agreed with the terms, 8D8 translated the Aqualish's words, . ===Holding out in Mos Espa=== {{Quote|Lord Fett? There is someone here to see you.|8D8, to Fett|{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}}}} Fett and Shand mustered allies to help them against the Pyke Syndicate.{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}} Upon realizing that the Pykes were striking, Fett and his assets positioned themselves in Mos Espa, 8D8 joining the Daimyo with Shand, the Twi'lek majordomo, and the [[Mandalorian]] bounty hunter [[Din Djarin]] at the ruins of the [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|Sanctuary]] [[cantina]]. The syndicate sent the [[Duros]] bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]] and some [[Pyke Syndicate Foot Soldier|Pyke back shooters]] past Fett's sentries to their position, where 8D8 stood watch outside. The droid subsequently went in to inform Fett that there was a visitor. While Fett faced Bane, 8D8 remained inside, but was soon joined by the others again when they received word that the crime families of Mos Espa had turned on the Daimyo's forces. While Shand left to counterattack, 8D8 stayed with the rest as they awaited the arrival of Pyke forces. When Pyke [[Soldier|troops]] arrived outside, the majordomo rose from beside 8D8 and convinced the Daimyo to let him negotiate with the enemy, the droid observing the exchange. ==Characteristics and traits== {{Quote|This 8D-series smelter droid was reprogrammed to deliver punishment to his mechanical brethren. And this synthetic sadist seemed to enjoy every moment of it!|R0-GR|}} [[File:8D8-tortures.jpg|thumb|left|300px|8D8 tortures a GNK power droid]] A lanky Roch Hive 8D-series smelter droid, 8D8 was a long-faced [[humanoid]] droid with a blank [[Color|white]] pair of [[photoreceptor]]s and body that stood 1.83 [[meter]]s tall and was designed with extreme durability. He was once a heavy-labor droid designed for industrial work. The droid also contained a [[logic processor module]] on his chest. 8D8, like most 8D-series droids, resented the more sophisticated [[Protocol droid|protocol]] and [[astromech droid]]s. A cruel industrial droid who was lobotomized and reprogrammed for sadism and to work in Jabba's droid torture chamber, he sometimes tortured other droids for his own amusement. 8D8 also loved to listen to the singer{{Databank|sy-snootles|Sy Snootles}} [[Sy Snootles]]' albums at sensor-shattering levels. In the service of Boba Fett, the smelter droid believed in the traditions of projecting strength in order to affirm leadership on Tatooine, suggesting the torture of two captured Gamorreans to the new Daimyo. 8D8 recognized a Night Wind assassin by his affiliation and reputation, cynically claiming to Fett that the assassin would never cooperate. 8D8 was initially cautious of uttering Jabba the Hutt's name to Fett, believing that it might insult the Daimyo. When Fett questioned such sentiment, the smelter droid regurgitated the excuse that the Daimyo had felt threatened and then apologized when his master was insulted by the claim. 8D8 was assertive with Lortha Peel, cutting the vendor off in a scorning manner when the man claimed no one respected Fett. While interrupting Fett's first training with his new rancor, the droid ignored the Daimyo's insistence that he was busy and continued with the news he had. After Jabba and Bid Fortuna’s deaths, 8D8 becomes majordomo to Boba Fett, daimyo to Tatooine, passing messages to his master, translating other languages, and coordinating day-to-day work. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:8D8-BYOR2D2-21.png|thumb|250pox|right|This 8D-series smelter droid has been misidentified as 8D8 in various sources despite is different markings.]] 8D8 was created for the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]]. In the film the droid was realized as a puppet that shared its body structure with [[BG-J38]], another droid used in Jabba's palace in the film.{{DB|droid|atedeate|8D8 (Atedeate)}} 8D8 was reintroduced into live action in the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', starting with the debut episode, "[[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land]]," which was directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]] and released on [[December 29]], [[2021]].{{DisneyPlusYouTube|t9Ca4ARSfqA|Next On Disney+ | December 2021}} In the series, he was voiced by [[Matt Berry]]. [[Chris Bartlett]] was credited in the episode as the performance artist of UK2-B in Chapter 1, though it was not immediately clear which character in the episode this credit referred to. Since the episode also featured a droid voiced by Berry, some fans and online publications assumed that Berry's character was in fact UK2-B,{{WebCite|url=https://thecinemaholic.com/what-is-uk2-b-in-the-book-of-boba-fett-does-matt-perry-voice-the-droid|text=What is UK2-B in The Book of Boba Fett? Does Matt Perry Voice the Droid?|author=Kundu, Tamal|date=2021-12-30|archivedate=20241104073744}}{{WebCite|url=https://www.hitc.com/en-gb/2021/12/30/uk2-b|text=Who Voices UK2-B in The Book of Boba Fett? Character Explained|author=Weston, Christopher|archivedate=20211230113640}} prompting [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] to [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Tweet]] that UK2-B was a different character from 8D8.{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1479959538325278721|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=UK2-B is unrelated. It's the droid that brings in the Gamorreans.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/bLbnj}} The [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] on [[StarWars.com]] used an image of 8D8 for the "Astromech (in Jabba's Palace)" entry{{Databank|astromech-in-jabba-s-palace|Astromech (in Jabba's Palace)|oldversion=20220313160025}} despite 8D8's [[canon]]ical droid model not being an astromech droid. The entry was later changed to cover an [[J7R-T|astromech droid]]{{Databank|astromech-in-jabba-s-palace|Astromech (in Jabba's Palace)}} featured first in "[[Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa]]" of ''The Book of Boba Fett'', which was directed by Rodriguez and released on [[January 12]], [[2022]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-january-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in January 2022}} ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' {{DLC}} *''[[Bounty Hunt]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Original Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *''[[Star Wars Battlefront]]'' {{DLC}} *[[Star Wars (2015) 70|''Star Wars'' (2015) 70]] {{C|Variant cover only}} *[[Dark Droids: D-Squad 4|''Dark Droids: D-Squad'' 4]] *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] *''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' {{Ab|Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!
